authority.client: renders proposals and sends editor choices; never supplies authoritative mechanics

rules: base_bundle_id references a certified, active, adopted PNG Builder bundle whose Ninja Book identities already exist and are approved
media_id references an attestation for the same narrative template and version
approved must be true before preview can seal
identity, personality, behavior, knowledge and limits are a mission-scoped editorial overlay; mechanics, PV, chakra and techniques remain those of the approved source profile

map.preview_authority: the server rereads mission_map_detail_v1 for the exact key/version, requires ready/selectable and exact spec equality, then blocks invalid geometry or insufficient capacity

budget.rule: the preview seals only the exact values currently admitted by Mission Generic and mission_narrative runtime policies

terminal_rules.authority: private server helper called by the pinned Mission Generic progress loop; no JSON event endpoint is executable by client or service_role
semantic_constraints: escape, protect_subject and reach_position require a stable subject_key
surrender_after_exchanges and survive_rounds require an integer threshold from 1 to 99
every rule belongs to a combat phase
reach_position requires current geometric intersection after a committed movement_settled event
for mechanical phases the exact same normalized actor JSON array is used by the scene and its encounter; allies and civilians join pg_team while at least one opponent remains
multiple simultaneous native matches fail closed
at most one non-standard native rule is allowed for each combat phase in the MVP

rpc.name: mission_rapid_compile_request_v1
rpc.mutation: idempotently creates a private queued draft

rpc.name: mission_rapid_catalog_v1
rpc.mutation: readonly adopted bundles whose exact mechanical binding and version are approved, including authoritative stats, PV, chakra and supported abilities; Mission Creation and map catalogs; exact current runtime budget

rpc.name: mission_rapid_media_ticket_v1
rpc.mutation: creates an expiring idempotent upload ticket bound to the owned draft, actor and adopted bundle

rpc.name: mission_rapid_media_register_v1
rpc.mutation: registers verified uploaded bytes as a review-state Ninja Book media version

rpc.name: mission_rapid_compile_claim_v1
rpc.mutation: claims one queued job and returns server policy plus source

rpc.name: mission_rapid_compile_reject_v1
rpc.mutation: records a terminal failure without retry

rpc.name: mission_rapid_preview_v1
rpc.mutation: validates all live dependencies and seals exact preview basis

rpc.name: mission_rapid_publish_v1
rpc.mutation: idempotent atomic resolve of approved PNG profiles plus mission overlay, seal/select plan, bind rules/media/map, prepare recovery and open board

steps: resolve approved Ninja Book profiles and mission-scoped editorial overlays
bind media, map and terminal rules
publication.failure: transaction rollback leaves draft editable and mission unopened

security.tables: RLS enabled and all privileges revoked from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated
security.public_functions: SECURITY DEFINER, search_path empty, explicit grants; legacy mission_rapid_terminal_evaluate_v1 is an always-deny stub with no callable grant
security.runtime_composition: progress_step is patched only from the exact live definition MD5; the first branch returns null for every mission without active rapid terminal rules; recovery restores the byte-equivalent stored function definition only if no later drift exists
security.media: the existing named Scorta branch is unchanged; mission uploads use a separate private ticket ledger and the same png_media_attest_v1 Edge with no client Storage write

upstream_compatibility.encounter_actor_scope: every encounter actor must be JSON-exactly present in scenes[].actors
upstream_compatibility.composition: mechanical scenes and their encounter reuse scene_actors without reconstructing either JSON array

test_environment.functional: Staff Test Room protected path after static review and reserved release
